name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-int-as-byte-union-256-p.bal
reason: The case asserts a runtime panic when casting an int|boolean value containing 256 to byte|boolean. Type casts, numeric literals, local declarations and function calls with required parameters are supported, with no restriction excluding casts involving unions or byte range checks. The asserted failed cast is within the supported type-cast behavior.
test_design_notes: The @panic comment marks the expected failure at the cast; main supplies the out-of-byte-range value 256.
